title: dbounce config export/import bundle
description:
Portable, human-reviewable snapshot of a dbounce deployment's runtime configuration. Produced by `dbounce config export`; consumed by `dbounce config import`. Per [[basic-app-hygiene-features]] TIER 1 #1.

Dialect handling: runtime_config.dialect names one of the four supported dialects. Each profile may declare which dialects it applies to (preserved on round-trip). The active rule pack is referenced by name+version (NOT embedded — pack content ships with the binary).

Schema additions are backwards-compatible: importers MUST tolerate unknown top-level fields + unknown sub-fields under rules/profiles items. format_version bumps only on a real shape break.

format.description: Magic identifier for this bundle shape. Sibling agents in ibounce + kbounce ship the same field with their own magic string (`ibounce.config`, `kbounce.config`) so a SIEM or unified config tool can fan out per product.

format_version.description: Bundle-format version. v1 is the initial shape. Importers reject bundles whose format_version > the importer's max known version.

exported_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the export ran.

exported_by.description: Operator id captured at export. Same resolution as --actor on every other admin command ($USER fallback, then 'unknown').

dbounce_version.description: The exporter's `dbounce --version` string. Informational; importers MAY warn on a major-version mismatch but MUST NOT reject.

schema_version.description: The store.SchemaVersion at export time. Import refuses when the importer's schema_version < exported schema_version (older binary cannot read a newer bundle). Equal or newer importer schema_version is always accepted (additive migrations only — see store.go).

dialect.description: Active dialect at export time. Import refuses when --dialect on the importing host does not match (a postgres bundle MUST NOT silently land on a mysql deployment). Override the check with --force at your own risk.

rule_pack.description: Reference to the dialect's embedded rule pack (BY NAME + VERSION — content lives in the binary at internal/packs/<dialect>.yaml; never inlined here so bundles stay small + dialect-pack drift across dbounce versions surfaces explicitly at import).

name.description: Pack name matching the dialect (postgres, mysql, snowflake, bigquery).

version.description: Pack metadata.version from the embedded YAML. Importer warns when the binary's pack version differs from the bundle's.

calibration_status.description: Pack metadata.calibration_status (calibrated / provisional / experimental). Informational; per [[scorer-is-ground-truth]] the operator MUST surface this in their change-management review.

embedded.description: Always true in v1 (packs always live in the binary). Reserved for a future external-pack feature.

rules.description: Every row in the rules table at export time. Insertion order preserved. Per [[creates-never-mutates]] import APPENDS — it never edits or removes existing rules. The optional `id` field is informational (the original row id); on import a fresh id is assigned by AddRule.

dialects.description: Per-rule dialect tags derived from the table-glob prefix (matches inferDialectsFromRulePattern). Empty/omitted means dialect-agnostic. Round-tripped for human review; not consulted by the rule engine.

active.description: The profile name selected via --profile / DBOUNCE_PROFILE at export time (or empty when none).

path.description: Absolute path the profiles.yaml was loaded from. Informational; the importer writes to its own configured profiles.yaml path, never to this one.

items.description: Full profile entries. Imported via AddLocalProfile per [[creates-never-mutates]]: an existing same-named profile is reported + skipped (use --replace to overwrite). Non-local-source profiles (Source != "" + Source != "local") are preserved on export but SKIPPED on import — they belong to a `profile install --from URL` flow.

dialects.description: Per-profile dialect tags derived from inferDialectsFromProfileNames. Empty/omitted means dialect-agnostic. Preserved on round-trip so a reviewer can see which dialects a profile was authored for.

pause.description: Active pause window at export time (or null when none). Pause windows are operational state — not re-played on import; included for informational change-management review.

tasks.description: Active task scopes at export time. Operational state — NOT re-played on import; included for informational change-management review (the importing host may have its own active tasks).
